brief:
U.S. physicians have documented the deterioration of healthcare in Gaza during the conflict, describing hospitals transformed into daily battlegrounds against death, according to Shehab Wire. Wounded arrive covered in blood, emergency rooms overflow with casualties, and medical staff face impossible choices as the health system buckles under the scale of injury.

The doctors' accounts provide firsthand testimony to conditions Palestinian health workers have reported throughout the war, with hospitals functioning as front-line facilities rather than places of healing. Their documentation describes the breakdown of civilian medical infrastructure during the conflict.
